whole.s: complete saved assembly for the raw.c body in dynamic_stack_base.
byte_offsets.c/.s: verbatim value expressions and saved target instructions from the pointer-offset route. Unrelated graphics lvalues are omitted, and expressions are passed to use().
The halfword load, byte/halfword stores, word void accesses and two negative byte displacements are measured; no table or pointee layout is inferred.
